95 cl volume shell|time=prep: 30 minutes|difficulty=2|image=[[File:ApplePie (brighter and warmer).jpg|300px]] }} __NOTOC__ {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]] | [[Cookbook:Vegan_cuisine|Vegan Cuisine]] Unlike with [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]], pie crust and other pastries should be made in a way that minimizes the development of [[Cookbook:Gluten|gluten]]. Once the water has been added, the dough should be worked as little as possible, to minimize toughness in the finished crust. == Ingredients == * 225 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] (1 [[Cookbook:cup|cup]]) [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]] * 2.5 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (½ [[cookbook:teaspoon|teaspoon]]) [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] * 230 ml (1 cup) cold vegetable [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]] * 30 ml (2 [[cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]]) cold water (add 15 ml of water as needed) == Procedure == # Combine flour and salt in medium bowl. # Cut in vegetable shortening with a [[Cookbook:Pastry Blender|pastry blender]] or two knives, until mixture is crumbly. # Sprinkle with cold water; mix just until mixture holds together. # Shape dough into a ball; place on lightly floured surface. # [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] dough to 3 mm (⅛ inch) thickness. # Line [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie plate]] with pastry. # Trim around perimeter for 2 cm (1 inch) overhang to fold under and crimp as desired (see pie crust edges below). == Pie Crust Edges == {{Main|Cookbook:Pie Crust Edges}} === Simple Fork Edge === # Fold overhang under and press down with your fingers. # Using the tines of a lightly floured fork, press the edge of the pastry to the rim of the [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]]. === Fluted Edge === # Fold overhang under and pinch to make the edge stand up. # With the thumb and forefinger of one hand, pinch the outside edge of the pastry, while pressing from the inside with the forefinger of your other hand. === Rope Edge === # Fold overhang under and pinch to make the edge stand up. # Press the pastry along the edge of the [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie plate]] between the side of your thumb at an angle, pinch and slightly twist. == Notes, tips, and variations == * To make two crusts, double all ingredients, follow procedure above, and divide dough in half. * Be sure to use cold water and keep well wrapped until use. [[Category:Vegan recipes|Pie Crust, Homemade]] [[Category:Baking recipes]] [[Category:Recipes_with_metric_units|{{PAGENAME}}]] [[Category:Recipes for dough]] [[Category:Recipes using all-purpose flour]]
